scope: Individual native-route mobility during danger reactions

reference.intent: Immediate reaction combines lower silhouette, local cover and direction/context-dependent evasive actions. Cover lowers standing actors to crouch; movement versus still/near context affects dodge.

finding: CBE immediate hard-cover branch protected CBE operations/reservations but ordinary native MOVE/path planning could still be forced prone or treated as an idle lateral-evasion candidate.
implementation: Extend existing committed-mobility decision after child-drill classification with native MOVE or PLANNING/REPLAN. Existing stance selector gives mobile crouch; idle cover/evasion and all native weapon/path/target controls retained. No source animation/route controller copied.
departure: Native authored movement receives stronger mobility preservation than the reference far-threat moving dodge branch. This is deliberate route-intent integration, not claimed whole-source parity or proven tactical superiority.
fullBuild: Passed checkpoint; physical acceptance remains absent

sourceIntent: brainAssess defers suppressed/PATH-disabled/stealth/STOP/hold-fire actors; group memory can invoke sympathetic inspection, indoor actor may reposition.

brainEngage retains useful native PLANNING, close dismounted CQB and distant native CANFIRE suppression. doAssaultMemory preserves BUSY nearby destinations, orders low-floor memory, consumes near/viewed positions and avoids unchanged doMove.
doReposition selects a nearby building position closer to threat and changes posture; these individual helpers are not whole-building safety/clearance proofs.
currentDisposition: CBE uses finite individual indoor/point FSMs, one epoch-bound unknown-body clue and group operations. availableTacticalCapacity20261020.sourceIntent: LAMBS brainAssess/brainEngage preserve protected native work and let individual memory/CQB actions coexist with group decision-making. CBE actual tactical assessment must agree with executor task/reservation availability; healthy armed headcount alone is not present manoeuvre capacity.
availableTacticalCapacity20261020.finding: Tactical assessment counted protected/reserved riflemen and AT/AA operators as currently available even though manoeuvre rosters refused those actors. It could propose unavailable roles and fall through repeated refusal to a whole-group reposition request, which separately deferred.
availableTacticalCapacity20261020.implementation: Shared fire-task/reservation predicate selects availableFoot from existing healthy local dismounted roster. Rifle threshold and AT/AA capability use available roster; no available actor returns HOLD/default empty candidates with ACTOR_TASKS_BUSY before low-firepower fallback. Dispatcher reports ACTOR_TASK_HANDOFF. Physical foot strength remains diagnostic, morale/vehicle priority and executor guards remain.
availableTacticalCapacity20261020.cost: One bounded existing read-only predicate per local foot actor, replacing later futile role attempts when all are protected. No world query/timer/controller or new movement. Runtime effect unmeasured.
